rationale: Only the largest 10% of disclosed models each year: tests whether the trend is driven by the growing tail of small models rather than by the frontier.
Only organisations that disclose repeatedly: removes one-off disclosures whose propensity may correlate with model size.
Language models only: removes composition change as domains enter the dataset.
Closed-weight models only: the subset whose disclosure is most likely selective.
Open-weight models only: the subset with the most complete disclosure.
